text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan was supposed to have asked me to help with her dance practice, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Phew, 10 sets of bicycle crunches complete!
The next routine is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying, Trainer?
What dancing requires is a strong core to support the body!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, we have to properly
wake up those iliopsoas muscles!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer, would you like to
join in too? Come on, let's muscle!
choice_data_list: Haven't you done enough strength training...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit!
Let's listen to the sound of our muscles waking up together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
One, two! Three, four!
Five, six! Seven, eight!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're working up a great sweat!
I'm getting into the groove too...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Phew, should this be good?
My muscles are completely awake and in high spirits!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer.
It's about time for our dance lesson—
choice_data_list: Sorry, I'm just a bit... tired...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh?
(Flump...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Trainer!?
Traiiiineeeerrrr!

Though she was utterly exhausted, she took a break
afterward and gave Mejiro Ryan advice
on her dancing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... My bad!
My muscles just moved on their own...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
All right, let's move on to dancing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: One, two! Three, four!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Right here—strike a pose!
Mejiro Ryan's dance was wonderful. However, one thing caught my attention—
choice_data_list: Maybe you could make your finishing pose a little cuter.
Maybe my signature pose could be a little cuter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Cu...!?
I-I guess that might be true...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Actually, I thought so too, so I've been secretly practicing cute poses... or maybe not...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
E-Eh!?
It's not really something to show off—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
B-But... maybe I could use it
in my dancing...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, here I go! With a smile—
R-Ryan, love, kyun—uuugh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh, I'm sorry!
It seems my facial muscles are still asleep~!!

Her dancing is on point, but it seems Mejiro Ryan
still has plenty of areas left to train.
